issues.title: Subagent runs fail with 'model_coming_soon' on MiMo-V2.6-Flash while the main session on the same model works fine

en.headline: Reworked repo summary site in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu and replied on an opencode
en.summary: All **9 own commits** landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, and the work centered on the generated repo-summary site. The site was re-rendered with a per-repo count pill and a teaser plus a fixed number on each repo card; the `byRepo` section was expanded to cover every repo instead of being cut at 8, and the AI fallback provider was switched from Zen to OpenCode Go (longcat → deepseek). Style fixes enlarged Chinese badge and tag fonts and tightened letter spacing, a CI job began rebasing to retry failed pushes, and `AGENTS.md` was updated with the workspace state and the new provider order. Another 23 automated commits were made by `github-actions[bot]`. No releases, pull requests, reviews, replies, or star activity were recorded. I also commented on `anomalyco/opencode` issue #56113, titled "Subagent runs fail with 'model_coming_soon' on MiMo-V2.6-Flash while the main session on the same model works fine", where the 6 comments reflect an active discussion.

zh.headline: 重构 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 的仓库摘要站点，并回复 opencode 模型报错 issue
zh.summary: 当天 **9 次本人提交** 全部落在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，内容集中在自动生成的仓库摘要站点：站点重新渲染并加上按仓库的条数 pill，首页 teaser 与每个仓库卡片都补上确定数字；`byRepo` 板块放宽条数上限，覆盖全部仓库而不是一直砍到 8 条；AI 备用 provider 由 Zen 换成 OpenCode Go（longcat → deepseek）。样式上放大了中文版徽章与标签的字号并收紧字距，CI 任务改为推送失败时 rebase 重试，`AGENTS.md` 也按工作区既有更新和新的 provider 顺序落定。另有 23 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。当天没有发布、PR、review、回复或 star 记录。我还评论了 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 issue #56113，标题为 "Subagent runs fail with 'model_coming_soon' on MiMo-V2.6-Flash while the main session on the same model works fine"，该讨论共有 6 条评论，互动仍在进行。
